summary: Batch E of the BLOCKERS audit: wired 9 deferred-scope Personalities as personality-wave-21 (Akodo Chiyo, Kitsu Ririko, Matsu Kaido, Matsu Miura, Kakita Maratai, Kitsune Ohsuki, Kitsune Tokoru, Utaku Mai, Shinjo Kinto) plus the two created-only tokens Ohsuki's Sparrow and Tokoru's Bear (real Oracle proxy cards, published like personality-wave-17's Lion Ancestor). Shared lane: the rules-side engine changes in src/L5R.Core/*.cs are the substance, but publishing also touches the client's shipped runtime art (src/L5R.Client/Content/Published/*.jpg) and the docs/CARD_INVENTORY.xlsx regeneration -- no UI/QoL logic changed. New primitives: CardDefinition.HonorRequirementWaiverClan (one shared controller-clan-conditional Honor Requirement waiver read by QuotePurchase, used for Chiyo/Crab and Ririko/Unicorn); MatchState.ProvinceDestroyedSinceTurnEnd (windowed per-player flag set at DestroyProvince, cleared at that player's own turn end); the own-personality-won-duel Reaction trigger broadening the duelWonReaction window (Maratai); enemy-attacking-card Target (Tokoru's Bear); attacking-one Effect (Kaido); MovementCannotBeNegated shared check (Kinto conditional on Reconnaissance, Wrathful Ancestor unconditional -- also closes a Champion of Thunder gap); Mai added to reinforcesFromElsewhere; CreatePersonality duringEntryReaction mode so Ohsuki/Tokoru create tokens inside their own entry window without clobbering it.
validation: dotnet run --project tests/L5R.Core.Tests (190/190 core, 57/57 published, 9/9 deck-format, 10/10 deck-workshop, including a new BatchEPrimitives regression test with real positive and negative assertions for every new primitive; mutation-checked against the nested-creation, turn-end-reset and Reconnaissance-province logic); bash tools/check.sh --skip-client (Python tools/content 43 tests + tools/collaboration 130 tests, L5R.AI.Tests 14/14, L5R.Server.Tests 5/5, L5R.Client.Transport.Tests 4/4) -- all green. PublishedTests pinned count recomputed 364 -> 375 (nine Personalities + two tokens).
